reasoning:
The ticket says: can_pass — "R = restricted (light vehicles only — vans may use a restricted road, heavy trucks may not)" per module docstring in R1. R1 states the docstring says A open to all, R light vehicles only, X closed to all. So can_pass: A → True for any vehicle; R → True only for van; X → False.

passable_route: route usable if at least one vehicle may use every road. Return (route, vehicle): truck if truck can use every road on that route, else van. Shortest usable route — pick min by (km, id) among usable routes, consistent with best_route. For each route, vehicle = "truck" if all roads passable by truck else "van" if all passable by van else unusable.

rerouted_sites: sites in name order where passable_route returns a route different from best_route's route (vehicle change alone doesn't count). Compare route ids.

notify_rerouted(sites, day): for each active household (load_households(active_only=True)) whose site is in sites and sms_ok is True, call queue_sms(hh.id, "DELIVERY_MOVED", {"site": hh.site, "day": day}). Return messages sent. Note queue_sms raises ValueError if sms_ok False — so filter sms_ok. "has agreed to receive texts" → sms_ok True. Return list of SmsMessage.

Should we also change distribution/planner.py build_plan to use passable_route? The ask lists only three items; "Done when: no delivery uses a road its vehicle may not use, trucks are sent whenever the route allows it". R8 says build_plan is "the caller that must be made status-aware". Hmm — the ask doesn't include changing planner, but the done-when implies deliveries must not use blocked roads. R8 explicitly says build_plan is the caller that must be made status-aware. But the ask says "Leave best_route as it is" and add passable_route. If build_plan still calls best_route, deliveries would still use blocked roads. The done-when criteria require changing build_plan to call passable_route. R8 supports this. I'll include a step for distribution/planner.py: replace best_route call with passable_route; if returns (route, vehicle) set route_id and vehicle, else status "unreachable". after P2.
